qualification: Local identity gates passed. Deployment and remote CI not performed. Overall production release still requires the remaining PRs.

concurrencyProof.instances: Two NestJS applications in one test process, separate Prisma clients/pools, shared restricted PostgreSQL runtime role
concurrencyProof.sameRecoveryCode: One success and one MFA_INVALID; different-code removals accumulate without restoring consumed codes
concurrencyProof.canonicalResponse: One refresh token and one access token across successful responses; successor returns the same pair during grace
concurrencyProof.revocationRace: Concurrent database rotation/revocation leaves the session revoked and clears the encrypted response
concurrencyProof.loginFailures: Eight parallel incorrect-password requests reach exactly five recorded failures and the existing account lock
concurrencyProof.credentialChange: Stale verification cannot create a session after a password change or account lock

policy.responseEncryption: AES-256-GCM using the existing shared ENCRYPTION_KEY
policy.history: Only previous generation; unknown older tokens are rejected without family attribution
policy.ciphertextRetention: One response per session; overwritten on next rotation and cleared on revocation. Expiry is a logical read limit, not a physical TTL purge.
